description: This class provides utility methods for handling product pricing, including formatting amounts, calculating final prices with attributes and discounts, and handling currency display in a sales or e-commerce application.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling product pricing, including formatting, discount calculations, and final price determination.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default price of a product without discounts.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final product price including attribute prices.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product based on configured prices and discounts, excluding attributes.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount for admin input fields.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a store's amount with currency in national or international format.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with a specified currency and locale.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with store currency for admin display.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with a specified currency.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Converts a string amount into BigDecimal, handling different formats.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total price for an order product.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Checks if a product price has an active discount based on date range.

methods.name: calculateFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product considering all availabilities and discounts.

methods.name: finalPrice
methods.description: Creates a FinalPrice object for a given ProductPrice, considering discounts.

methods.name: discountPrice
methods.description: Calculates and sets discount percentage and discounted price for a FinalPrice.
